title: Start here · Faction Training Playbook

hero.eyebrow: New to Torn? Read this first
hero.lede: The things nobody tells you in your first weeks: what to set up, how to keep what you earn, and the traps that cost new players the most. Then pick a path.
hero.quote: "Most new players don't lose because they're weak. They lose because they carry cash, skip the setup, and buy the wrong things. Fix that first and everything else gets easier."

week.title: Your first week
steps: A bigger energy bar that refills faster: about {donatorGain}% more natural energy every day you play. A donator pack gives 31 days and sells for ~$24M in game, or costs about $5 in real money. Baldr: "Everyone should have donator status."
Rent the best happy you can keep paying for.
Rent a Ranch or Mansion (at least a 925-happy Penthouse) until level 15, then a Private Island with an airstrip. Don't buy property yet. PI budget →
Most job perks unlock at 3★. Short on work stats? Pay the director to train you. Which job for your path →
Your first course: it opens the +1% gym-gain courses. Always keep a course running. Education plans →
Hold off on the new-player missions.
They pay energy (up to 500 at a time), and that energy trains better once you've moved into higher-happy housing. Rent first, then do them. Missions →
Mugging is common. Buy the Stock Ticker (50 points) and learn ghost trades. Keep your money →
Even a 1-week term. It's the start of your passive income, and it earns a merit.
Set up your API keys safely.
One key per tool, least access, never a Full key in a script. Scripts & tools →
Every award earns a merit, and merits buy permanent upgrades. The easy ones are below.

merits.title: Cheap early merits
merits.intro: Each of these honors earns a merit for almost no effort:
head: Honor
How
rows: Historian
Spend 5–10 minutes reading a Chronicle in the newspaper.
Forgiven
Pray at the church twice a day, 8–10 hours apart. Takes about 7–10 days.
Pious, Saintly
Donate $100k, then $1M, to the church.
Pocket Money
Make any bank investment. A 1-week term is fine.
Energetic
Reach 1,000 energy: start empty and stack 4 Xanax, like you would for a jump.
Diabetic
Eat 500 candy. Lollipops cost about $1k each and top up your happy too.
Spinner, One in Six
1,000 roulette spins (about 14 days at 75 a day), and 50 Russian roulette wins on $1 bets.
Protege
Finish the mission "Introduction: Duke".
Mule, Souvenir
Import 100 items from abroad, and buy the "perfect souvenir" on a trip.
Luxury Real Estate
Upgrade a Private Island with an airstrip. A friend can lend you theirs for two minutes.
Holiday logins
Log in on New Year's Day, Valentine's Day, Halloween, 15 November (Torn's anniversary) and Christmas Day.

missions.title: Missions
new: They teach the basics and pay energy, nerve, cash and mission credits. One step alone pays 500 energy.
Move into better housing first, so that energy trains at higher happy.
They offer a piggy bank once. It's a safe, one-time store for cash. Skip it and you never get another chance.
reg: Not a priority before level 15; they can use a lot of energy.
Save your credits for things cash can't buy: special books and weapon upgrades.
Never spend credits on anything you could buy with money. Some books are great, some are useless (see Books).

safe.eyebrow: The #1 way new players lose progress
safe.title: Keep your money
safe.lede: Cash in your pocket can be mugged. Store it as soon as you have it. No method is perfect, so most players use a mix.
head: Where
How it works
The catch
rows: Ghost trade
Open a trade with a friend, add cash, and neither of you accepts. Fast in and out, even from hospital.
Trades close after 6 hours, the other player must have been active in the last 6 hours, and only use someone you trust.
Bank
Lock money in a 1-week to 3-month term. It earns interest and nobody can mug it.
You can't touch it until the term ends, and when it ends the money sits idle until you start another.
Stocks
Buy shares (needs the Stock Ticker, 50 points). Sell any time for a 0.1% fee.
The price can drop while you hold.
Items and points
Hold Xanax, donator packs, flowers, plushies or points. Items can't be mugged.
Price them near the lowest listing when you sell, or they sit.
Faction bank
Most factions hold money for members.
Withdrawals need leadership, and factions have lost vaults to bad leaders. Keep only what you need there.
Piggy bank
A one-time mission offer. Holds any amount, safe from muggers.
The only way out is breaking it, all at once. Miss the offer and you never get another.
PI vault
Unlimited safety up to the vault size ($1B for the extra-large).
Only in a PI you own, not one you rent.
tips: While you're online, reset a ghost trade every 3–5 hours so it never expires.
Avoid the Cayman Islands bank for storage: muggers wait for players landing to deposit or withdraw.
When a bank term ends, the money stays safe but stops earning. Start the next term right away.

selling.title: Selling what you buy
where: Item market: the quickest place to sell. It takes a 5% fee.
Bazaar: your own shop, about 250 points to open. Buyers find it through tools like weav3r, and 100 different customers earns the Middleman merit.
Trade Chat: for big or bulk sales. Always use a trade window, never "send the money first".
how: Price at or near the lowest listing to sell fast. Check weav3r for bazaar prices before buying or selling; bazaars are usually cheaper than the item market.
Selling big amounts draws muggers. Move the money right after the sale.
Flowers and plushies sell to set-builders, or you can trade full sets at the Museum once you have the History degree.

books.eyebrow: Big boosts, badly timed by most
books.title: Books
books.lede: Books come mostly from mission credits and subscriptions. Most last 31 days, so the whole trick is timing: read one when you'll actually use it all month.
head: Book
Effect
When to read it
rows: Gym Grunting, Self Defence In The Workplace, Speed 3, Limbo Lovers 101
+30% gym gains in one stat (Strength, Defense, Speed, Dexterity) for 31 days
Read during a month you focus that stat
Get Hard Or Go Home
+20% gym gains on every stat for 31 days
Any heavy training month
Ugly Energy
+100 max energy and +100 per refill for 31 days
Worth +28–78% if you max-train that month
Smuggling For Beginners
+10 items per trip for 31 days
A big flying month, or Tourism Day
Mailing Yourself Abroad
Flights 25% faster for 31 days
Pairs with the one above
Brawn Over Brains and the other +5% stat books
+5% to one stat, up to 10M
Save them until that stat is at 200M, then read
Ignorance Is Bliss
Happy above max doesn't reset for 31 days
Only if you can afford to jump constantly. Watch for overdoses

drugs.eyebrow: The quiet cost of daily Xanax
drugs.title: Drugs & addiction
drugs.lede: Every drug adds a little addiction, even before the brain icon appears. Overdoses are covered in Field medicine; this is about the slow build-up.
what: A battle-stat debuff: the brain icon, redder as it gets worse.
Lower effectiveness at your job, from your very first drug.
At higher levels it can kick you out of your education course.
Over 150 Xanax and Ecstasy in total locks you out of the drug-free Sports Science Lab gym.
keep: Rehab in Switzerland (~$250k) clears it. Fly there when the brain icon turns red.
The Addiction Mitigation merit (−2% per upgrade) softens the effects.
Jobs: Cruise Line and Flower Shop (5★) can reduce addiction; a 10★ Nightclub keeps education safe from it.
Faction upgrades: Toleration cuts addiction by up to half. Faction upgrades →

scams.eyebrow: Don't learn these the hard way
scams.title: Scams and traps
items: Loss buyers who don't pay. Use FFScouter's prepaid loss contracts. Otherwise check the buyer first: an account under 100 days old, under $1B networth, or with lots of enemies is a red flag. Follow their instructions exactly, or they'll use it as an excuse not to pay.
Ghost trades with strangers. They can see your cash, cancel the trade and have it mugged. Only use friends or faction mates.
"Paste your key here." Never put a Full-access API key into a script or website. Key safety →
Cayman bank runs. Muggers camp there for players carrying cash in or out.
Trusting any vault blindly. Faction vaults have been emptied by bad leaders. Spread your money.
The casino. Only worth it for the $1-bet merit honors. Beyond that it's a money sink.

faction.title: Faction basics
respect: Faction attacks earn respect, which buys upgrades for every member.
Multipliers stack: fair fight up to ×3, war hits ×2, a long chain up to ×2, a retaliation ×1.5, attacking abroad ×1.25.
When a member gets hit, the faction loses a quarter of the respect the attacker gained. Easy targets cost everyone.
faction.helpTitle: How you help, even while small
help: Take organized-crime roles you can pass. OCs →
Chain hits on targets you beat easily; FF Scouter shows who.
Carry medical items for wars. Field medicine →
Don't take off right before a war or chain. Flight delays →
faction.quote: "Nobody expects a new member to carry a war. We expect you to show up, take the hits you can win, keep your meds stocked, and not be the easy target that feeds the other side."

routine.title: Your routine
day: Check in often enough that your energy never sits full.
Train. One stat per session, in the gym with the best dots for it.
Take Xanax when your cooldown clears, if it's in your budget. Use your point refill (25 points).
Spend nerve on the hardest crime you pass reliably.
Fly while your energy refills; check YATA first.
Spend job points on your company specials.
Store your cash before you log off.
week: Renew 1–2 week bank terms the day they end.
Claim weekly stock payouts; they disappear after 24 hours.
Make sure the next course is queued before the current one ends.
Check your OC slot with the faction.
month: Renew your property lease. Leases end at 03:30 TCT.
Renew donator status (31 days a pack).
Time any 31-day book for the month ahead.
